about.title: About
app.dropTitle: Drop to send to your phone

battery.title: Battery {level}%
cam.hintAdmin: Administrator permission is needed once (the camera is registered as a driverless Windows component).
cam.hintUpdate: The camera component was updated. “Enable camera” registers it again with administrator permission (close apps that use the camera).
cam.loadFailedHint: The background service may not be responding. Try again in a moment.
cam.step1: 1. Select “Enable camera”. “T-Bridge Camera” appears in Windows.
cam.step2: 2. On your phone, start streaming in T-Bridge → Remote control → Camera.
cam.step3: 3. In your app, choose “T-Bridge Camera” as the camera.
cam.subtitle: Use your phone as a webcam on this PC (Zoom, Teams, Camera app…)
cam.title: Phone camera
cam.trouble1: If the camera is not listed, restart T-Bridge and the app that uses the camera (Zoom/Teams).
cam.trouble2: If the picture says “Waiting for phone”, the stream on the phone is off or the connection dropped.
cam.trouble3: Having the phone and PC on the same Wi-Fi network gives the lowest delay.
cam.trouble4: The T-Bridge version on your phone does not support the camera. Update the phone app.
cam.win11: This feature is designed only for Windows 11.
consent.alwaysAria: Always allow: do not ask again for this phone
consent.body: wants to view your screen. If you allow it, the phone can see this PC’s screen and use the mouse and keyboard.
consent.timeout: Denied automatically if there is no reply in {n} s
consent.title: Screen sharing request
crash.autoHint: If a crash happens, a report is prepared and shown the next time you open the app. It stays on this PC; sending it is up to you.
crash.body: T-Bridge closed unexpectedly last time. Personal data has been removed from the report below. Nothing is sent automatically; if you choose to send it, it opens on GitHub.
crash.bodyManual: The report below was prepared from the latest log entries, with personal data removed. Nothing is sent automatically; if you choose to send it, it opens on GitHub.
crash.title: Crash detected
files.emptyBody: Files shared from your phone are saved to:
files.needPhone: Pair a phone first to send files.
files.offline: Your phone is offline. Files are queued and sent when it connects.
files.ready: {name} is ready. Anything you drop is sent right away.
fw.body: Windows needs to allow access once so your phone can reach this PC.
fw.notGranted: Access was not granted. Try again and confirm the Windows prompt.
fw.title: No firewall access
home.help1: Is T-Bridge open on the phone and are both devices on the same Wi‑Fi? Guest networks stop devices from seeing each other.
home.help3: Turn Wi‑Fi off and on again on the phone; turn off any VPN.
home.help4: If it still fails, client isolation / AP isolation must be off on your router.
home.lastClipEmpty: Send text you copied on your phone with “Send clipboard to PC” in the notification. It appears here and in your clipboard.
home.noNetwork: No network connection found. Check that you are connected to Wi‑Fi.
home.nowPlayingEmpty: Music or video playing on your phone shows up here.
home.pairStep2: Tap Pair with QR and scan this code.
home.pairStep3: Or pick {name} from the list and enter the code:
home.pairTitle: Connect your phone to this PC
home.subNew: Pair your phone once to get started.
home.subOn: Connected · clipboard, files and notifications are syncing
home.subPaired: Connects automatically when T-Bridge is open on your phone and both are on the same Wi‑Fi.
invite.t-desktree.body: See what fills your disk and get a notification on your phone when space runs low.
invite.t-desktree.title: Disk analyzer
invite.t-downloader.body: Speed up your downloads, follow them from your phone and send links from your phone.
invite.t-downloader.title: Fast download manager
invite.t-ramcash.body: Clean your PC’s RAM with one tap and monitor it from your phone too.
invite.t-ramcash.title: Memory cleaner
notifs.accessHint: T-Bridge needs “Notification access” permission on your phone.
notifs.muteConfirm: Stop showing notifications from {name}? (You can turn them back on in Settings)
notifs.offlineBody: Once connected, your phone’s notifications appear here.
notifs.summary_one: {n} notification · dismissing it also clears it on your phone
notifs.summary_other: {n} notifications · dismissing them also clears them on your phone
remote.findBody: Rings at full volume for 30 seconds, even in silent mode.
remote.hint: To control your PC from your phone, use the Remote control tab on the phone: touchpad, keyboard, media, volume, presentation and power.
remote.nothingHint: Controls still go to the last player on your phone.
remote.offline: Phone not connected. Once connected, you can control it from this page.
reply.failed: Could not send the reply. Try again.
reply.timeout: The phone did not respond. Check the connection and try again.
set.autoEcoHint: When your phone connects, installed T-Suite apps (T-RamCash, T-Downloader…) open in the background.
set.autoUpdateHint: New versions download in the background and install quietly when no transfer is running. Your phone asks for the update itself.
set.autostartHint: Runs quietly in the tray without opening a window.
set.clipSyncHint: Text you copy is copied on your phone too.
set.encryptedHint: Only devices you have paired can connect.
set.firewallNo: Not allowed. Your phone may not be able to connect.
set.firewallOk: Allowed. Your phone can reach this PC.
set.languageHint: The app language. “System language” follows Windows.
set.lowBatHint: Notifies you when the phone drops below 15%.
set.notifMirrorHint: If turned off, phone notifications are not received at all, and sounds and alerts stop.
set.notifSoundHint: Plays a short, soft sound for each new notification.
set.restartNote: The new folder is used after the app restarts.
set.screenAllowed: Devices that can always see the screen
set.screenHint: Your phone can view this PC’s screen and use the mouse and keyboard. Each new phone is asked for approval the first time, and an indicator shows at the top while sharing.
set.screenRevoked: Screen permission removed for this device
set.tagline: A bridge between your phone and PC
set.themeHint: The dark theme is designed for T-Bridge.
set.updError: Could not check for updates: {e}. Check your connection and try again.
set.updIdle: Updates are checked in the background
set.updLatest: You are on the latest version
set.updReady: v{v} is ready. It installs automatically once transfers finish.
set.winToastHint: Also show an alert at the bottom right (off by default).
suite.intro: Manage your T-Suite apps on this PC and your phone in one place.
